name: Alphalete - Fix Log
body:
> Log · Alphalete · 2026-10-08

Also: `seo-audit-2026-09-11\fix-backups` and `seo-audit-2026-09-11\Alphalete-SEO-Change-Log.csv`

# Summary
Alphalete has two local "before" backup folders, plus several other local snapshot sets and server-side backups that are referenced in project files. Each row says what the change was, so a revert path can be found quickly. Server paths are references only; nothing here was re-checked on the server.

# Local backup folders
| Date | Folder | What it backs up | Change made |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-09-11 | `seo-audit-2026-09-11\fix-backups\2026-09-11_otto-hidden-content\` | `*.before.html` snapshots of home, about-us, service-areas, drain cleaning and residential pipelining; `otto_state_before.md`; a verify script | Audit issue I01: undeployed OTTO hidden content (nlp_terms, nlp_faq, missing_keywords, dynamic_indexing, missing_headings). `otto_state_before.md` lists every OTTO item ID so any one can be redeployed. Verified live the same day. |
| 2026-10-08 | `fix-backups\2026-10-08_llms-claims\` | `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt` as they were before the edit | Lesson Step 1: removed the "20-year warranty", "100% satisfaction guarantee" and "Free Video Inspection" lines (and a warranty FAQ in llms-full). Phone, hours and legal-name lines left alone pending the Agency owner. Logged in the change log CSV on 2026-10-07 with review date 2026-10-21; server copies in `~/tag-backups/2026-10-08_llms-claims/`. |

# Other local snapshot sets (not in a fix-backups folder)
| Date | Location | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-06-12 | `wp-elementor-fixes-2026-06-12\` | `_cur` / `_v2` / `_final` HTML and Elementor JSON for blog posts 12650 to 12691 and the Black Forest and Boone pages. See [Alphalete - Blog Elementor Fixes 2026-06-12](lib:brain-alphalete-blog-elementor-fixes-2026-06-12). |
| 2026-09-17 to 2026-10-01 | `page-sheet\page-sheet.backup-*.html` | 7 backups of the Page Sheet HTML before refreshes. See [Alphalete - Page Sheet](lib:brain-alphalete-page-sheet). |
| 2026-06-16 | `Alphalete - All Pages and Posts (backup before index update).xlsx` | Inventory copy kept before the indexed-status update. |

# Server-side backups referenced in files
| Date | Server path (per the file) | Covers | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-05-27 | `~/alphalete-pre-seo-backup.sql` (about 1.1 GB) | Full database before the May SEO work | site-audit-tracking.docx |
| 2026-07-08 | `~/_seo_maint/wp_postmeta-2026-07-08.sql` | Full wp_postmeta before restoring 84 pages' SEO meta and setting noindex | Sitemap Fix README |
| 2026-07-08 | `~/_seo_maint/tier1_backup_2026-07-08.json` | Tier 1 city page bodies and meta (12 pages) | Sitemap Fix README |
| 2026-07-08 | `~/_seo_maint/tier2_backup_2026-07-08.json` | Tier 2 city pages (36 pages) | Sitemap Fix README |

# Key fixes recorded elsewhere
- 2026-05-30: wrong-city title bleed and "Alphalette" typo fixed on location pages; 131 titles standardized (see [Alphalete - Website Repo and mu-plugins](lib:brain-alphalete-website-repo-and-mu-plugins)).
- 2026-07-08: sitemap hijack by MetaSync fixed with mu-plugin `zzz-rankmath-owns-sitemap.php` (see [Alphalete - Sitemap Fix 2026-07-08](lib:brain-alphalete-sitemap-fix-2026-07-08)). Note the SEO head later moved to OTTO only.
- 2026-09-11: nav link to the redirecting camera URL repointed; sitemap junk excluded (audit I03, I14).
